narrative.overview:
Relay is an Operate product: reviewed company context becomes a bounded representative and campaign, and each customer attempt becomes an attributable conversation, commitment, or proposed improvement. The interface gives the operator one clear place and next action while preserving the records underneath. DM Sans, cool white and lilac-gray surfaces, indigo emphasis, restrained status color, and Lucide icons remain the visual identity; the workflow extensions change composition, not the brand world.

The shell presents five working areas—Overview, Company, Agents, Campaigns, and Activity—with Settings separate. Company now carries a durable customer-table intake from import through mapping, row review, and atomic apply. Saved per-actor revisions, explicit AI suggestion use, source-wide exceptions, prepared bulk decisions, truthful counts, recovery paths, and the canonical customer handoff keep the source record visible. Imported do-not-contact restrictions remain separate from channel permission. Agents remains one continuous build-test-publish workspace and adds a 960px sequential Text rehearsal: reviewed redacted checkpoint, exact-version candidate reply, exact quoted AI evidence, explicit operator verdict, preserved attempt history, and required-suite truth. The rehearsal suite never publishes an agent.

Campaigns remains one durable record across Intent, Audience, Agent & content, Review, Run, and Results. Partial setup saves preserve incomplete truth. Optional AI brief and content proposals stay separate and attributable until explicitly used or applied to the same campaign. Review checks current authority and eligibility; launch separately freezes the run snapshot. Run owns controlled recipient execution and the mounted browser call. Results remains a distinct evidence surface. The workflow-finish reviewer returned SHIP for durable customer intake, its customer handoff, and Text rehearsal after final 1265px, 659px, and 375px captures; the malformed unused mobile capture is excluded. The verification packet reports 746 passing tests plus the production build/package check. This is scoped workflow evidence, not a release gate, Realtime/audio benchmark, hosted-channel result, external-delivery claim, or whole-product production claim. No new asset or motion obligation follows.

rules.name: The State Before Decoration Rule
rules.body: Use indigo, green, rose, and small motion to explain location, action, or record state. Do not introduce color as a quality claim.

rules.name: The Record Readability Rule
rules.body: Keep working copy and controls at 13–14px; reserve 10–12px type for supporting metadata, never for a required decision or action.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Keep containers flat at rest. Use a border, wash, or one small transient shadow to establish hierarchy; never use elevation to imply confidence or model quality.

dos: Do organize destinations under Overview, Company, Agents, Campaigns, Activity, or Settings while preserving a clear owner for each saved artifact.
Do keep inactive navigation groups collapsed and retain old routes through aliases, search, contextual links, and anchors.
Do derive Overview from saved company readiness and current records, then present one next action with its evidence.
Do prioritize active campaign work over optional channel setup and treat only the latest unresolved exact-version failure as attention.
Do keep the agent picker compact, editor spacious, tester continuously mounted, and Save draft / Test agent available from the toolbar.
Do preserve raw editing buffers, focus the first invalid field, and guard route and history exits when the draft is dirty.
Do run checks against an exact saved version, publish explicitly, then pass the active release into a separate Channel draft.
Do keep all six Campaign phases on one durable record with partial saves, exact revision checks, and a fixed launch snapshot.
Do keep AI suggestions and proposals as attributable receipts until an operator explicitly uses or applies them.
Do keep customer intake resumable per actor, reconcile whole-source counts, expose exception filters and source-wide exclusions, and separate prepared bulk decisions from atomic Apply.
Do preserve imported customer fields through the canonical handoff while keeping source do-not-contact restrictions and channel permission separate.
Do build Text rehearsal from a reviewed redacted checkpoint, generate a new reply from one exact agent version, preserve failed attempts, and require explicit operator verdicts over exact quotes.
Do bind required-suite truth to the latest attempt, current case set, runtime/configuration, knowledge authority, and blocking reviews while keeping older attempts inspectable.
Do keep Results separate from Run and distinguish provider acceptance, reviewed evidence, and business outcome.
Do preserve viewer limits, consent controls, explicit AI identity, anonymous/unverified participant labels, and human-review boundaries.
donts: Don't restore the former 18 peer destinations or a three-column agent workbench.
Don't treat historical failed checks as current attention or let optional deployment displace running campaign work.
Don't repeat prompt fields across sections, unmount the tester during section changes, or hide the artifact targeted by Save, Test, Publish, or Channel setup.
Don't bypass the dirty guard for Back, Forward, hash links, search, agent switching, or contextual navigation.
Don't allow viewer accounts to mutate, test, publish, send, or create actions; keep records readable and limitations explicit.
Don't let a draft test, configuration check, release, or prefilled Channel draft imply public activation, live delivery, voice quality, identity verification, or business value.
Don't turn a Campaign phase change, partial save, AI proposal, preflight, or provider receipt into implied approval, launch, delivery, or success.
Don't let AI mapping, bulk preparation, a saved intake review, or a source handoff silently change customers, grant contact permission, or clear an imported restriction.
Don't hide skipped, excluded, blocked, pending, stale, or historically failed evidence behind a completed batch or passing latest result.
Don't treat a Text rehearsal judgment or passing required suite as a publication gate, Realtime/audio benchmark, live-channel result, or production claim.
Don't duplicate execution controls in Results, hide empty planned-field states, or collapse recipient evidence into campaign-level claims.
Don't present either focused review verdict as a whole-product usability, production, hosted-channel, voice-quality, or competitor-superiority claim.
